title: Infographics / Infograms

location.series: IBM Design Language / public web guidelines
location.extent: Complete webpage content-area capture; visible default tab states

slide_intent: Preserve numerical meaning in a compact graphic so a small supporting statistic remains useful rather than becoming a decorative icon.
strategic_value: Infograms that share IBM pictogram construction while depicting real data can connect brand consistency with concise evidence.
demonstration: The webpage compares six infogram types, standard and radial grids, measured strokes, rounded data positions, type alignment and decimal kerning, then color-emphasis rules.
practical_value: Choose a compact chart type, preserve data accuracy at its scale and distinguish the highlighted value through both shape and color.

content_islands.name: Types and foundation
content_islands.spec: Place six compact chart specimens above standard and radial construction grids.

content_islands.name: Construction
content_islands.spec: Follow a dimensioned stroke-and-point diagram with the numeric stroke table and standard-grid data approximation examples.

content_islands.name: Density and radial accuracy
content_islands.spec: Compare readable and crowded point counts, then show percentage-marked radial grids for donut and gauge forms.

content_islands.name: Typography
content_islands.spec: Place left, center and right value placements above the decimal-kerning do/don’t pair.

content_islands.name: Color and emphasis
content_islands.spec: End with monochrome and two-color examples followed by pairs testing filled hero points, contrast and matching quantifier color.

reference_purposes.Intent: The introduction distinguishes real-data infograms from pictograms that merely symbolize charts and explains their role in small spaces.
reference_purposes.Expression: Fine strokes, sparse data points and compact numeric values connect infograms visually to productive IBM pictograms.
reference_purposes.Application: The page uses a 32px master grid, a 28px standard-grid data height and a 1.5× highlighted-point stroke, with separate radial accuracy guidance.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Radial data accuracy takes priority over snapping to the grid. Do not rely on color alone; two-color infogram elements require at least 3:1 contrast.

ingredient.name: Infogram data construction
ingredient.role: Keep a small statistic readable and quantitatively meaningful.
ingredient.application: Use the 32px master grid; constrain standard-grid data to 28px and round proportional positions to the nearest grid integer. On radial grids, prioritize accurate values over snapping.
ingredient.scope: IBM infograms representing real data. These are not generic pictogram rules; the source explicitly permits radial points between grid lines.

inspection.method: Six uniformly spaced sampled frames across the complete clip
